text: おれは　カツラが　ポケモン　はじめた　きっかけを　しってるぜ

structure.jp: カツラが　ポケモン　はじめた　きっかけを
structure.en: what got Blaine started with Pokémon

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: カツラが　ポケモン　はじめた　きっかけ
patterns.explanation: The whole phrase before きっかけ describes it, with no linking word needed. カツラが　ポケモン　はじめた　きっかけ = 'the thing that got Blaine started with Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている; with しる it means the knowing is ongoing. しってる = 'I know'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes what you say with confidence. しってるぜ = 'I know, you see!'.
